items.title: Introduction of General Bills and Confirming Bills
items.stake: About by-laws. No action was taken on this item.

items.title: Building New Homes: Phase Two of the Purpose-Built Rental Housing Incentives Stream - Update
items.brief: Phase two of the City's push to get more purpose-built rental homes built. Council gets the update on the incentives meant to turn approved rental projects into actual homes — and decides whether to keep going with them.
items.stake: The official summary names a figure of $1.5 billion. No action was taken on this item.

items.title: Responding to Bill 140, the Building Ontario Faster Act, 2026
items.brief: Toronto's answer to Queen's Park. Bill 140 is the province's newest housing bill — still in committee at Queen's Park, not yet law. Council decides how the City responds, and how much say Toronto keeps over what gets built here.
items.stake: A citywide decision. No action was taken on this item.

items.title: Composition and Appointment Changes to Various Agencies, Boards, and Corporations
items.brief: Who runs what. Council sets the memberships of the agencies, boards and corporations that deliver city services for the new term. It sounds dry — it's where a lot of the city's real work gets assigned.
items.stake: About appointments. No action was taken on this item.

items.title: Extension of 2026 Debenture and Temporary Borrowing Authorities
items.brief: The City's borrowing permission. Council extends its debenture and temporary borrowing authorities — the permission to borrow for the big projects on Toronto's books — carried into the new term.
items.stake: The official summary names a figure of $2.0 billion. No action was taken on this item.

items.title: 39 Wynford Drive - Proposed Designation By-law Under Part IV, Section 29 of the Ontario Heritage Act - Consideration of Objection
items.brief: Heritage protection for 39 Wynford Drive in Flemingdon Park — a 1962 International Style office building designed by Peter Dickinson Associates. The owner objected, but staff say it still qualifies; Council decides by December 2 or the designation lapses.
items.stake: About heritage properties. No action was taken on this item.

items.title: 55 Elm Street - Proposed Designation By-Law under Part IV, Section 29 of the Ontario Heritage Act - Consideration of Objection
items.brief: Heritage protection for 55 Elm Street — an 1891 building built for the Canadian Temperance League, part of the most intact surviving stretch of the old St. John's Ward. The owner objected; staff propose clarifying the designation wording, and Council decides by December 2 or it lapses.
items.stake: About heritage conservation districts. No action was taken on this item.

items.title: 55 Sudbury Street - Proposed Designation By-law Under Part IV, Section 29 of the Ontario Heritage Act - Consideration of Objection
items.brief: Heritage protection for 55 Sudbury Street in Little Portugal — the 1899 Diamond Glass Company office building, Romanesque Revival in red brick and stone. The owner objected, but staff say it still qualifies; Council decides by December 2 or the designation lapses.
items.stake: About heritage designation. No action was taken on this item.
